data.content_ref: inline:The claim in SRC_004 depends on the 'Type I/Type II error' framework established in SRC_002, where 'lapse errors' are mapped to Type II errors (omissions) and 'knowledge errors' are mapped to Type I errors (misinterpretations). This relation is refuted if 'lapse errors' are found to produce Type I errors (e.g., forgetting to check a 'NOT' condition, leading to a false positive).
